title: Prose for a Painting
answer_short: The generated English poem may not work well with Shakespeare style transfer when the style transfer dataset does not have similar words in the training set of sentences.
answer_rationale: Text 1 explicitly states that the model's limitation is its inability to perform well with Shakespeare style transfer when the style transfer dataset lacks similar words in the training set, leading to low content scores. This indicates a constraint in the model's ability to generalize across datasets with insufficient lexical overlap.
